_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. calm.com compiles its styled-components theme into literals, so the product's own pages declare no --* token layer to alias; the only declared layers the captured surfaces carry are third-party: Zendesk Garden's --zd-* set on the /faq/web help center (emitted under core.zd) and WordPress presets on health.calm.com (raw only). Both the light marketing set and the dark app-shell set are built from measured computed styles (raw/components-computed.json).
